steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: uq.propagate, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {model: "linear", coefficients: [2, 3], intercept: 1, variables: [{name: "x1", dist: "normal", mean: 10, std: 2}, {name: "x2", dist: "uniform", min: 0, max: 6}], method: "moments"}, target propagate → PASS with mean 30, variance 43 (= 4·4 + 9·3), Sobol indices {16/43, 27/43} — the NIST/SEMATECH propagation-of-error values, never from the solver's output.

Determinism + convergence leg: the monte-carlo and lhs samplers are seeded (mulberry32; Box–Muller normals; LHS by stratified quantiles with a seeded permutation) — the same inputs + seed reproduce the same estimates bit-for-bit, which is what makes a stochastic method CI-signable; the seeded Monte Carlo (N = 20000, seed 12345) sits within 5 standard errors of the analytic mean, and both samplers ship the analytic mean/variance beside the sampled estimates they must converge to. Product-model leg: exact mean/variance for independent inputs with first-order Sobol analytic and the interaction remainder left visible (first-order indices sum to less than 1, reported as such).

Engine-tier leg: target engine → NOT_COMPUTED requires_engine_tier:sxe-22 — the general tier (a wrapper around arbitrary solvers, polynomial chaos, sampled Sobol indices) is the stats-uq engine stack's scope, refused by name, never approximated in JS; with the engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-22 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: more than 16 variables, or a sample count outside 100..200000 → refused naming the bound; NaN / 1e300 / negative-where-physical-positive input (e.g. a negative std) → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
